estimates.assumptions: Standard 200g pot of creme fraiche (full fat assumed for typical recipe use; recipe mentions controlling calories with low fat but defaults to full fat for taste).
Modest topping amount of grated Parmesan for 4 servings (about 7-8g per person); realistic for 'grate over the top' without excess.
Standard 150g per chicken breast (skinless, raw/edible portion); common size for 4 breasts in a meal serving 4.
Standard 25g per bacon rasher/streaky slice (raw weight); modest amount for 4 rashers to accompany the chicken.
Modest 'topping' or side amount of fresh spinach for 4 servings (about 50g per person); realistic edible portion for greens with the meal.
Modest 'topping' or side amount of peas for 4 servings (about 50g per person, drained if from frozen); typical edible portion to accompany the gratin and chicken.
